purpose: Develop a response-blind same-order versus different-order transfer test that separates taxonomic composition from source-geometry composition and calibrates the paired statistic against the exact deployment geometry rather than assuming a zero-centered structural null.

parent_failure.interpretation: inferential deployment-geometry failure only; not a biological rejection of lineage-conditioned transfer

response_blind_geometry_diagnosis.diagnostic_conclusion: The v0.2 same-order and different-order source pools differ materially in overlap, centroid distance and graph size, with larger imbalance on the character-mask survivor geometry. A taxonomic source contrast can therefore inherit a geometry contrast.

estimator_development.source_mass_normalization: retain the existing N_train/N_selected scaling separately in each equal-count matched pool

matching.smaller_group_rule: use every source in the smaller supported group and down-select the larger group
matching.algorithm: deterministic hardest-first greedy nearest-neighbour matching in target-standardized feature space with lexical tie breaking
matching.standardization: within each target across the complete geographically supported source universe; population SD with unit fallback for constant features

development_inference.primary_calibration: worst-case upper-tail Monte Carlo envelope across independent exact-geometry private-null reference distributions

screening_success.private_cells: each private evaluation cell must have <=5 rejections among 50 worlds on both the development geometry and the exact confirmatory survivor geometry
screening_success.positive_cell: same_order_A2 must have >=35 rejections among 50 worlds on both geometries
screening_success.scope: method-development screen only; these thresholds do not authorize empirical opening

pre_protocol_exploration_disclosure.note: Before this protocol was frozen, two-world local exploratory checks were used only to see whether geometry matching alone obviously solved the v0.2 centered-bootstrap failure. They used a different development seed tag and are excluded from all v0.3 reference and evaluation worlds.

formalization_rule.if_screen_passes: freeze a separately named formal v0.3 qualification with entirely new formal reference/evaluation seed namespaces and high-precision Type-I/power gates before any formal result is generated
formalization_rule.if_screen_fails: do not tune thresholds on the same worlds; either abandon the order route or define a newly named development estimator with new development seeds
